cwd: the materialized fixture vault (no path flag in argv)
description: The environment every recorded case ran under. The caller's environment is cleared and rebuilt from this allowlist so nothing the host carries can reach a case.
notes: Recorded output is verbatim except for the placeholders described under `placeholders`.

`{{VAULT_ROOT}}` in a case's `plan_template` is a different thing again, and deliberately spelled differently: it is an INPUT token the recording substituted for the vault path before invoking, where `<VAULT>` is an OUTPUT substitution applied after.
The locale is pinned rather than forwarded: glyph selection reads LC_ALL -> LC_CTYPE -> LANG, so a forwarded host locale makes the recorded glyph set a property of the recording machine.
HOME and the XDG bases point into a scratch tree owned by the run, so any registry, cache, config, socket or log a binary creates for itself is created fresh and discarded with the run.
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is a short temp dir: it holds an AF_UNIX socket path, and a long base overruns sun_path.
A read case shares one materialized vault per fixture; a mutating case gets a fresh vault of its own so its writes reach no other case.

extraction_masks.note: Applied by the extraction itself, proven necessary by re-running the whole catalog twice and requiring byte equality. A case declares the ones that fired on it in its `volatile_masks` field. A mask fires only on a NONEMPTY value: an empty field is a fact about the invocation — a write-free path mints no telemetry id and computes no plan hash — so an empty value is recorded verbatim and the case declares no mask. The recording harness had its own whole-value substitutions for the telemetry id and the plan hash; they are not applied here, because erasing a value makes a minted-but-volatile id indistinguishable from one that was never minted. These masks replace them and keep the two apart.

values.<PLAN_HASH>: a plan hash computed over the absolute vault root, so it tracks the temporary directory
values.<TRACE_ID>: a telemetry id minted per invocation

inherited_normalizations.note: Substitutions the recording harness applied before the extraction saw the bytes. A case declares the ones it carries in its `normalizations` field, never in `volatile_masks`.

values.<VAULT>: written by the `vault-root` normalization: the absolute path of the materialized fixture vault, in every spelling the platform reports

placeholders.note: Two kinds, and a case declares them in different fields. Do not read one as the other.
